title: Hypha standard model library index
description: Qualified-name index over the SysML v2 / KerML standard model libraries (ISQ, ScalarValues, SysML.sysml, ...): declaration surface only - name, the keyword that introduced it, and where it is declared - never a resolved specialization graph. Generated by tools/knowledge-gen.

declarations.description: Keyed by qualified name, e.g. "ISQ::mass" or "ScalarValues::Real". Same-file collisions keep the first occurrence, since both still resolve to the correct page; a collision across two different files is a generation error.

kind.description: The literal keyword(s) that introduced the declaration, e.g. "attribute def" or "datatype" - the source's own words, not a resolved metaclass.

file.description: Path to the package page, relative to knowledge/<tag>/model-library/.

source.description: The upstream source path, e.g. "sysml.library/Systems Library/Parts.sysml".
